class.name: CSGBevelModifier
class.brief_description: Creates a flat bevel on sharp edges of generated CSG geometry.
class.description: Rebuilds generated CSG geometry by insetting adjacent faces, adding a chamfer along qualifying edges, and closing the resulting corners. Coplanar triangulation edges are ignored. As a geometry modifier, it is applied to the owning shape and temporary copies of its child operands before their Boolean operation. The modifier creates a single flat bevel segment.

members.member: Minimum angle in radians between neighboring faces for their shared edge to be beveled.
Distance in local units by which adjacent faces are inset from a beveled edge.
